item.title: SSRF Field Guide — Breaking Trust Between Servers

item.title: The Full SQL Injection Spectrum — 18 PortSwigger Labs

item.title: Talking an AI Into Trouble — Prompt Injection Lab
item.description: Demonstrates original security research: I built a deliberately vulnerable AI assistant, then broke it four different ways to show why LLM apps need threat models too.
